entities.name: COQ9
observations: Exact sequence match to Drosophila melanogaster UniProt Q8MKN0 COQ9; 326 aa mature precursor sequence analyzed.
Mitochondrial ubiquinone-biosynthesis protein that binds aromatic isoprenoid intermediates and presents them to COQ7 for the COQ7 hydroxylase step.
Sequence-derived properties: molecular weight 36,342.9 Da, theoretical pI 7.73, GRAVY -0.4525, instability index 47.3.
Predicted mitochondrial targeting peptide spans approximately residues 1-43/44 in homologous curated annotations; mature chain follows.
Contains Pfam COQ9_N (PF21392.4; residues 109-136) and COQ9 (PF08511.17; residues 220-290).
Curated homolog annotations place COQ9 at the mitochondrial inner membrane and in the ubiquinone biosynthesis complex; it can form homodimers and higher-order COQ7:COQ9 assemblies.
No explicit catalytic reaction was retrieved; COQ9 is functionally an accessory lipid/isoprenoid-binding factor rather than an established enzyme.
